subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client eligible for the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but it changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and establishes a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve after rebase
options.body: Accept this narrow `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require conflict resolution, and leave app placement and command policy to the linked product issue.

options.title: Rename before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to a maintainer-preferred generation-neutral id and refresh the external app/proof before merging.

options.title: Keep external for now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose the first-party or external ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept this narrow `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require conflict resolution, and leave app placement and command policy to the linked product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway protocol identity and auth-boundary behavior where `steipete` is the strongest routing signal in recent related history.
